grades.quote: the intent is that RDCYCLE is used for performance monitoring along with the other performance counters.
grades.reason: Describes the RISC-V cycle counter (RDCYCLE) and time counter for performance monitoring. It does not cover selecting events or configuring event counters, so it only gives limited auxiliary information.

grades.quote: |9:0|EvCode|RW|The event number of the performance event being monitored.
grades.reason: Directly describes how LoongArch software selects an event (EvCode) and enables counting per privilege level (PLV0-3) and overflow interrupt (PMIEn) through the PMCFG register.

grades.reason: Gives the LoongArch performance monitoring structure. Each monitor has a configuration register (PMCFG) and a counter register (PMCNT), with their CSR addresses and how to find the number of monitors. It does not detail event selection fields.

grades.quote: This extension provides a means for M-mode to allow writing select counters and event selectors from S/HS-mode.
grades.reason: Introduces RISC-V counter delegation, which lets M-mode allow S/HS-mode to write counters and event selectors. It gives context on who can configure counters but not how events are selected or counted.
